<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 4"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Gusting Spell](/Feats.aspx?ID=5529) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Air" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=527" />
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=645" />
<trait label="Spellshape" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=513" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 82

**Archetype** [Winged Warrior](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=227)

**Prerequisites**
[Winged Warrior Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5527)

</column>

---

You manipulate the currents of your spell's energy, allowing you to gracefully glide with your wings. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell with the [air](/Traits.aspx?ID=527) or [electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=586) trait, you can [Fly](/Actions.aspx?ID=2312) up to 10 feet before or after the spell is cast.
name: Gusting Spell
